canon_requests.section: Canon §12, new §12.4 Time of day and weather (DECISIONS 99; doc 09 G26). MUST BE MERGED with doc 03 Canon gaps G31, which proposes the same record as a canon §5.12 table
canon_requests.new: **Time of day and weather.** Each Folio rolls one time of day from its genre's table and one weather state (doc 12). Time of day sets the sky channel's source level (doc 03 §10.2). A weather state's terms apply only at cells whose doc 03 `sky_src` bit is set. Its stealth fields are `fog` (whole fog points added to the genre fog, §12.2), `sound_bp` (multiplies sound path attenuation), `ambient_db` (added to the ambient mask), `precip` (0 or 1: scent lasts 1800 ticks) and `snow` (0 or 1: footsteps read `noise.surface.snow`); doc 09 §15.3 applies them. Core states: clear 0, 10000, 0, 0, 0; rain 0, 11000, 5, 1, 0; storm 1, 12000, 10, 1, 0; mist 1, 10000, 0, 0, 0; snow 1, 11000, 0, 1, 1; dust 1, 11000, 5, 0, 0.
canon_requests.why: DECISIONS 99 lands in doc 09; §15.3 reads five stealth fields of the Folio weather state on sky cells and a §8.2 ring shows them. CONFLICT: doc 03 §4.8 already carries its own proposed canon table (IDs `tod.dawn/day/dusk/night` with `sky_delta`; `wx.clear/rain/storm/fog/snow/dust` with `sky_delta`, `sound_ddb`, `precip`, `fire_bp`) and applies `sound_ddb(wx)` per propagation step into `sky_open` cells. The two proposals disagree on section (§12.4 vs §5.12), state names (doc 09 'mist' vs `wx.fog`), the sound model (doc 09 Bp multiplier `sound_bp` at the emitter vs doc 03 per-step `sound_ddb`), the cell predicate (`sky_src` vs `sky_open`) and snow's precip (doc 09 1, doc 03 none). One table must carry both chapters' columns. Harvest recommendation: keep doc 03's IDs, section and columns `sky_delta`, `sound_ddb`, `precip`, `fire_bp`; add doc 09's `fog`, `ambient_db` and `snow`; drop doc 09's `sound_bp` column and its `wx_sound` term; doc 09 reads its terms on `sky_open` cells.
